name: Poisoned Pearl
body:
School conjuration (creation) [poison]; Level: jester 2

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 standard action
Components: (not included in source material)

EFFECT

Range: Medium (100 ft. + 10 ft./level)
Target: one creature
Duration: 1 round
Saving Throw: Fortitude half; see text; Spell Resistance: yes

DESCRIPTION

The target suffers 1d4 points of phrenic damage +1 point per caster level . In addition, the target is affected as if by a slow spell and a ray of enfeeblement spell for 1 round. The target is also unable to take a 5-foot step until the end of your next turn.
